connectorUiConfig.title: BitSight Security Ratings (Serverless)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: The BitSight connector provides the capability to ingest security ratings data from the BitSight Security Ratings Platform. The connector provides visibility into company security posture, findings, breaches, alerts, and statistical data across your portfolio of monitored companies.

sampleQueries.query:
BitSightCompanyDetails_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| project TimeGenerated, Name, GUID, Industry, RatingIndustryMedian
| take 10

BitSightFindings_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| project TimeGenerated, CompanyName, RiskCategory, RiskVector, Severity
| take 10

BitSightBreaches_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| project TimeGenerated, Companyname, Severity, EventType, Text
| take 10

dataTypes.name: BitSightCompanyDetails_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
BitSightCompanyDetails_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| summarize Time=max(TimeGenerated)
| where isnotempty(Time)
